_note: The keys on screen (hud.ts drawKeyHints, main.ts keyHintsNow): what a new player needs to know to play, as a short description and the key or keys bound to it right now, so a rebind shows at once. Up on the right under the FPS for everyone until they hide it with the keyHints key (binds.json, / by default), and remembered either way (the owner, 2026-09-29: "make default the options/buttons to be displayed on the page, with a clear press [button] to hide this ... on the right side, below the FPS, showing short description + button(s) ... this will help new players"). A row lists its actions' first keys (a row of one action shows up to `keysPerAction`); `games` limits it to a game, and `when` to a moment: `range` only in the range, `friends` only with friends in the match or the range. Ours.
